lines.text: Tommy the turtle got a shiny pair of four-wheeled roller skates for his birthday!
He pushed off the porch, wobbled sideways, and BONK! fell flat on his hard shell!
I'm clumsy, I have zero balance, I quit! Tommy grumbled, wiping away a tear!
Wise Badger rolled over smoothly and said, Nobody is born an Olympic roller champion!
Every time you stumble and fall, your brain muscles learn how to balance better next time!
Tommy strapped on his helmet, tightened his knee pads, and tried taking two small glides!
Gliding left, gliding right! By evening, he was coasting down the path with the wind in his face!
Mistakes are not stopping signs—they are stepping stones toward becoming amazing!
Never give up and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily encouragement!
